owner_canon: Rumi lived in the castle for hundreds of years; gunk trapped her underwater.
Grand Puff is restored to his own rainbow self, not replaced by a new bunny.
Dust bunnies are endearing pests; Baby Eagle remains trapped beneath two of them.
